1. The whole image goes to the provider you chose for Soft edges.
2. In the engine, MODNet scales the image to -1 to 1.
3. If the image is smaller or larger than 512 pixels, it is resized so the shorter side is 512.
4. Both sides are rounded down to a multiple of 32.
5. MODNet answers with an alpha matte from 0 to 1, which is resized back to the image.
6. The matte replaces the selection as a soft selection. It is labeled as an AI result.
